name: Auto Components, Batteries and Lubricants

seo.title: Auto Parts and Lubricants Claims | VipraTech
seo.description: Warranty claims, mechanic loyalty points, distributor schemes and dealer incentives, checked for auto component, battery, tyre and lubricant brands.

hero.headline: Check warranty claims and mechanic loyalty payouts before they are paid
hero.subheadline: Battery, tyre and parts warranty claims, mechanic loyalty points, distributor schemes and retailer incentives, checked against your terms and sales.

intro: Aftermarket auto components, batteries, tyres and lubricants reach vehicle owners through distributors, retailers and mechanics. Brands pay for warranty replacements, reward mechanics for choosing their products and run schemes for distributors and retailers. Serial numbers, scan data and sales records make each of these checkable.

challenges.title: Warranty replacements
challenges.detail: Pro-rata and replacement warranties on batteries and tyres are claimed through dealers.

challenges.title: Mechanic loyalty
challenges.detail: Mechanics earn points by scanning codes, and bulk scanning inflates payouts.

challenges.title: Distributor and retailer schemes
challenges.detail: Volume schemes and retailer incentives run across many SKUs.

challenges.title: Frequent price changes
challenges.detail: Price revisions on channel stock create rate difference claims.

use_cases.note: Battery, tyre and component warranty claims checked against serial numbers, sale dates and pro-rata terms.
Mechanic and retailer loyalty points compared with sales by town, with bulk scanning flagged.
Distributor volume schemes checked against circulars and invoices.
Retailer and distributor incentives calculated from billing, returns and collections.
Price-change claims on channel stock capped at estimated stock on hand.

documents: Warranty claims with serial numbers and job cards

faqs.q: Can it check pro-rata battery warranties?
faqs.a: Yes. Pro-rata and free-replacement periods are configured per product, and each claim is checked against the sale date.

faqs.q: Our mechanics scan through an app run by a vendor. Does that work?
faqs.a: Yes. The checks work from the app's exports and return redemptions to release or hold.
Distributor claims settlement is live and dealer incentives are pilot-ready. Warranty and loyalty validation are in early access.
